title: research(ct47–49): finite cross-factor Hom and explicit non-split Richelot neighbors
body:
## CT47: exact finite-extension 2-power torsion compatibility [pcc:unverified]

**Result.** For the two fixed F101 elliptic factors (traces -7 and -11), E[2^s] and F[2^s] are isomorphic as Galois modules over F_(101^k) **if and only if**

```
s <= v2(k) + 2 + (1 if 3 | k else 0).
```

Weil anti-isometries can be chosen at exactly those levels by centralizer norm adjustment. The least k for full 2^s torsion is 2^(s-2) for every s>=3. This gives a sharp extension-depth obstruction even when Frobenius-power traces coincide: at k=3,6,12 the extra trace divisibility does not imply conjugacy at the next level.

The all-depth written proof reduces odd extension factors using the 2-primary congruence kernel, uses exact trace valuations when 3 does not divide k, and uses normalized matrix determinants modulo four (1 vs 3 or 3 vs 1) for the 3-divisible case. This extends CT46's sample witnesses to a classification for **every positive k and s**; it does not claim novelty beyond standard 2-adic matrix methods.

**Reproduction:**
- `python3 -B experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct47/ct47_extension_depth.py`
- `python3 -O -B experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct47/ct47_extension_depth.py`
- `node experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct47/ct47_independent.js`
- `node --no-opt experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct47/ct47_independent.js`

Python performs exhaustive 2x2 search on 48 small (k,s) cases, exact power-of-two trace checks, normalized determinant controls and constructed Weil determinant -1 witnesses. Independently coded JavaScript checks additional ranges and anti-orientation witnesses. A bounded four-part workflow replays the checks. Local Python normal/-O and Node normal/--no-opt checks were performed on the new algorithms; **the precise committed head still requires its own CI receipt and independent scientific signing**. The first cyclic-witness implementation failure at k=2 is recorded in the proof, including its correction. No tests weakened.

Research-KB/locked atlas and live EKS/S3 admission were inaccessible; no benchmark or spending action. This finite-torsion module compatibility is not an elliptic isogeny, Jacobian kernel certificate, or full ECDLP speedup. Principal polarization, ramified/nonsplit divisors, native Phi/Psi, cold rho/IC and faithful Lean remain separate obligations. [pcc:unverified]

## CT48 — full 2-adic Smith/Hom enumeration [pcc:unverified]

Commit [fa9f4c31](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/commit/fa9f4c31c2ea50f18bca1b4ec3e5f1873d49c5a7) adds an independent minor-gcd Python verifier, a separately encoded JS 2-adic pivot verifier, exact all-extension proof and bounded workflow. For r=v2(k), the Smith valuations of X ↦ F_{-11}^k X − X F_{-7}^k on four coordinates are (0,0,r+2,r+2) when 3∤k, and (r+2,r+2,r+3,r+3) when 3|k. The exact number of equivariant maps on 2^s-torsion is 2^{Σ min(s,a_i)}. Thus there are 16 maps for k=1 at all s≥2, but 1024 at k=3 for s≥3. These finite-level modules admit many nongeometric maps even though the elliptic factors have geometric Hom=0. [pcc:unverified]

Commands: python3 -B / -O -B ct48_smith.py and node / node --no-opt ct48_independent.js within experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct48. Local runs: 129 Smith cases in each independent program, 15 exhaustive small finite Hom cases in Python, deliberately mutated trace rejected. Exact-head [CT48 scoped CI #43264353677](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/actions/runs/43264353677) **passed** on the committed source; scientific signing remains unavailable. No cost or speedup inferred. [pcc:unverified]

Report: [CT48_LOCAL_SMITH.md](experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct48/CT48_LOCAL_SMITH.md). Prior CT47 proof/workflow and stacked parent lineage retained. Research-KB service unavailable in this environment; previous papers and primary sources used instead. No paid compute, ledger rewrites or protection bypass. [pcc:unverified]


## CT49 — explicit non-split Richelot neighbor candidates and parity gate (2026-11-12) [pcc:unverified]

**New component.** Using the four actual even-sextic two-glue sources Cpi1, Cpi2, C10, C20 from [root #3877](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/pull/3877), independently enumerated each source's three F101-Frobenius-stable branch matchings. The even quadratic pairing has zero Richelot determinant; the other two have determinants respectively **(50,51), (81,20), (73,28), (34,67)** in F101 and admit explicit bracket-built smooth genus-two sextic target presentations. This gives **eight exact target equations**, paired by x->-x into at most four distinct F101 isomorphism classes. Their coefficients and no-retwist counts are in [CT49 report](experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct49/CT49_NONSPLIT_RICHELOT.md); no new 72-catalog classes are claimed.

**Independent arithmetic.** Standalone JS computes the cubic-extension roots, three quadratic factors, Frobenius covariance, determinants, bracket polynomials, F101 descent and all eight target coefficient lists; independently written Python checks exact F101 and F101² point counts on all seven old/new sources, character formula and Frob³ on genus-two 2-torsion. Additional standalone local Python independently rebuilt each codomain and verified irreducible six-cycle target sextics. All eight codomains independently match N1=120,N2=10436,#J(F101)=12317. Local Python normal/-O and Node normal/--no-opt passed. Exact-head CI and independent PCC science signing must be inspected separately. [pcc:unverified]

**Mathematical obstruction.** The old four-glue T0/T1/T2 (irreducible six-cycle) each have 4 F_(101³)-rational 2-torsion classes; the four two-glue sources (3+3) each have 16. Hence no **odd-degree isogeny directly from T_i to these two-glue sources** can exist over F101. This does not contradict existing C0-to-two-glue degree7/49/101 constructions, since those do not start at T_i. Standard Richelot/Frobenius theory, not a novel generic theorem. [pcc:unverified]

**Reproduce**: python3 -B/-O -B experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct49/ct49_branch_audit.py; node and node --no-opt experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct49/ct49_richelot.js. Bounded CT49 workflow added, with its own exact-head status pending. Editable diagram [ct49-branch.dot](experiments/chained-transfer-reference/ct49/ct49-branch.dot). This remains a **codomain/kernel construction**, not an evaluated Cantor morphism: whole-12,317-class map, nonsplit/ramified/infinity fibres, dual [2], native orientation and matched full costs remain to be executed. No paid compute, new EKS jobs, frozen ledger rewrites, force/rebase or merge override. Research KB/locked atlas unavailable; sources are in report. [pcc:unverified]

**Parent and merge**: remain stacked on #1510; retarget to main/enable auto-merge only after upstream parents merge and all CI/review/PCC gates allow it.


### CT49 exact isomorphism closure and independent cubic replay [pcc:unverified]

Now additionally committed: a **second self-contained Python F101³ implementation** of all eight exact Richelot codomains and all stable matching determinants, plus an independent C++17 exhaustive PGL₂(F101) binary-sextic equivalence checker with self-, x↦−x-positive and mutant-negative controls. Across **18 pairwise comparisons** (12 against the old T0/T1/T2, six between the four new shift-1 representatives), every one of the **1,030,200** PGL₂ substitutions per pair gave zero equivalences even allowing an arbitrary nonzero scale. Therefore the eight target presentations represent **exactly four distinct F101 curve-isomorphism classes**, none twist-equivalent to the old T0/T1/T2. These may still overlap the wider fixed 72-Jacobian catalog and need not give distinct *unpolarized* abelian varieties. [pcc:unverified]

Full optimized/unoptimized Python, Node and g++ checks pass. **Exact-head [CT49 Actions #43276111590](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/actions/runs/43276111590) passed all four arithmetic steps** on commit \`f7d4c6be\`, including the independent Python target reconstructor, JavaScript target/point-count verifier, Python Frob³ audit, exhaustive C++ PGL₂ checker. PCC science signing remains unavailable, [pcc:unverified]. No full Cantor/dual/ramified support evaluation or cold solve.
